description: This file defines the TestLogger class within the SuiteCRM\Test namespace. The class is used for logging method calls and notes, including recording backtraces, and provides methods for retrieving notes filtered by severity levels. It appears to be a testing utility class for logging purposes.

classes.name: TestLogger
classes.description: A utility class for logging method calls and notes, including backtraces, in testing scenarios.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the TestLogger class, resetting internal log storage.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls, logs the method name and arguments, and records a note entry with backtrace information.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes filtered by specified log levels, which can be a string or an array of levels.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the stored calls and notes.
